33:23.text: Among the believers are men true to what they promised Allāh. Among them is he who has fulfilled his vow
, and among them is he who awaits

33:24.text: That Allāh may reward the truthful for their truth and punish the hypocrites if He wills or accept their repentance. Indeed, Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.

33:25.text: And Allāh repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage, not having obtained any good. And sufficient was Allāh for the believers in battle, and ever is Allāh Powerful and Exalted in Might.

33:26.text: And He brought down those who supported them among the People of the Scripture
from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts
you killed, and you took captive a party

33:27.text: And He caused you to inherit their land and their homes and their properties and a land which you have not trodden.
And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.

33:28.text: O Prophet, say to your wives, "If you should desire the worldly life and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and give you a gracious release.

33:29.text: But if you should desire Allāh and His Messenger and the home of the Hereafter - then indeed, Allāh has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward."

33:30.text: O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for Allāh, easy.
